title: Patient
description: Core patient demographic and contact record used across all five agent pillars.

patientId.description: Unique patient identifier. Format: PAT-XXXXXXXX (8 digits).

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be in the past.

gender.description: Patient gender. Used for conditional logic (e.g., pregnancy question for females aged 15–55).

phone.description: Primary contact phone number. International format preferred.

email.description: Primary email address for communications and outreach.

messagingConsent.description: Whether the patient has opted in for messaging outreach. Required by Retention Agent before any contact.

dataProcessingConsent.description: Whether the patient has consented to data processing.

consentDate.description: Timestamp when consent was last updated.

segmentType.description: Patient segment classification used by Retention Agent. chronic = 3+ visits with chronic condition; wellness = regular checkups; one-time = single visit.

lastVisitDate.description: Date of the most recent visit. Null if no visits recorded. Used by Retention Agent to identify 6+ month inactivity.

branchId.description: Identifier of the primary clinic branch the patient is associated with.

unresolvedClinicalIssue.description: If true, Retention Agent must suppress all outreach.

unresolvedBillingIssue.description: If true, Retention Agent must suppress marketing outreach.

contactFrequencyCount.description: Number of outreach contacts this month. Max 2 per month per patient.

contactFrequencyResetDate.description: Date when contactFrequencyCount resets to 0 (1st of next month).

suppressionFlags.description: Suppression flags used by Retention Agent to prevent inappropriate outreach.

isActive.description: Whether the patient record is active in the system.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when patient record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when patient record was last modified.
